notes.title: Changes in the rules of the game.
notes.content:
Changes in the rules of the game.
1. Coin.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868001/6b49ad5728d502b2494772807cb925945e55be1f.png
Now the bonus coin during the final calculation of the received bonuses adds not 10 score points as before, but 50 score points. This bonus is now the most important in the game.



2. Zones.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868001/03af8a36095528bb14e288c220096db5b16865ab.png
Under your feet on the tabletop, you see numbered zones from 0 to 5, the most advantageous of the zones is 0 (that half of the table on which zombie sausages spawn). Depending on the zone number, every second you receive a certain number of score points. This is not profitable, since each 1000 score points during the game is the appearance of a boss and then a new wave of zombie sausages.
In zone 0, you will receive 0 score points every second.
In zone 5, you will receive 5 score points every second.
AND
In zone 0 you will receive a maximum of bonuses.
In zone 5, you get the least bonus.
Remember, the more bonuses , the greater the final score of your progress.

Other changes.
      Mini radar to indicate the closest enemy. Located on the crosshairs.
Indication.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868001/abaa5b57fbb646cd0ebc13700661cbb355ea9662.pngFront left.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868001/000feb37f080a8645c578fc9f7d0458c6e269d3a.pngFront right.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868001/90bbf5e81950c71c71210484f53b7e1ec4d3bf10.pngBehind left.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868001/db95c110092b476c13ede167968d64100d9dedf0.pngBehind right.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868001/f7c4237b1319c31a7e9828c3186c7dac62cab2a1.pngIndication of the intention of an enemy attack (a red star appears on the crosshair from the side from which the nearest enemy is located).

      Now you can adjust the mouse sensitivity in the 'OPTIONS' menu. Also during the game, causing a pause with the 'Esc' button, you will be able to change the sensitivity of the mouse. From the pause, you can now exit with the 'Esc' button on the keyboard.

      Skipping scoring. Now you can not waste time waiting for the final scoring, press the 'Esc' button on the keyboard or the 'skip counter' button on the screen and you will receive the final score instantly.
      
      More feedback when a bullet hits a sausage (Animation of the face is added - now the sausage is blinking or surprisingly widening the eyes).

In the future there will be another leaderboard "Best of the best" which will contain the total number of points from all locations.

Any comments or feedback are welcome.

notes.title: NEW RULES
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868001/13f8dc582980c91d56bd4fcacb3fcb89ef0cb554.jpg

In anticipation of the new location, I slightly changed the game and from today new rules of the game come into force.

Now on the table there are plus zones that prevent you from earning points. The higher the value of the zone, the less points you earn. +5 is the biggest, 0 is the smallest. At the beginning of the first wave of zombie sausages, you will have 30 seconds to familiarize yourself with the zones. Now there are 5 waves in the location, 1000 points for each wave. At the end of each wave, a mini-boss is waiting for you and if you win over it, you are given 30 seconds to take a breather before the next wave. (You can skip the wait by pressing the 'ENTER' key)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868001/cc98343a1d517782564de5f239593f1c74b1b711.jpg

For a cup you can not hide now.
When approaching a cup , it starts to rotate and the handle can push you or sausages off.

Fixed bugs with the sudden disappearance of sausages.
Fixed random sausage rotation when losing you as a target.
Added the ability to select a music track for the game menu.

Fixed a previous non-public update error where it was impossible to continue the game due to pressing the 'ENTER' key to skip the wait pause.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868001/6ff9056e9cf458e363513c03af856135373fa966.jpg

That's all for now. I will continue to build the next location and the addition of the existing one.

If you have any ideas for improving the gameplay, I will be very happy.

notes.title: FROM THE SAUSAGE HEAD
notes.content:
Officially the first update.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34868001/581525e2b18597464715cc819749dd508bc5a91b.jpg


What is fixed:
Now you can not stand on the sausage head to score an infinite number of points. (Ha ha ha)
The bonus circle now has the correct size after losing a new game.
When you drop the mini-boss off the table, you can now continue the game. 

What is added:
Added items on the table in the location.

What is changed:
Bonuses now disappear with the passage of time.
Red sausage has become even faster 2.25 times.
Jetpack is now spending twice as fast.
The health of the mini-boss (hell-sausage) now increases with every 1000 points and the blow of the mini-boss is now getting stronger and stronger.
Several textures have been changed.

That's all for now. Super boss will appear in the next update.
